audit.kitLine: Activates when landing Full Charge att
audit.effectOrReason: Header → trigger {kind:'shotFired'} (every SR trigger pull is a full charge, chargeFrames 60); target {kind:'allies'} (includes self, no excludeSelf). 'within the effective range' assumed always true vs the single boss.

audit.kitLine: ATK ▲ 15.2% of the skill user's ATK
audit.effectOrReason: buff casterAtkPct 15.2, durationSec 5, target allies. 'of the skill user's ATK' = flat add scaled off CASTER ATK → casterAtkPct, NOT atkPct.

audit.kitLine: Activates when attacking w/ Full Charge
Spy Lens: stacks up to 10 time(s)
audit.effectOrReason: Stack COUNT modeled as resource {name:'spyLens', delta:+1} per full charge, capped at 10 — the only consumer is skill2's max-stack gate. Placed in skill1 so the increment dispatches BEFORE skill2's gate reads the pool (slot order), giving the correct 10th-charge unlock.

No StatKey for effective/minimum range in types.ts; the +30% full-range bonus is engine-automatic and takes no kit modifier. Verbatim line recorded in unmodeled.skill1. NOT a weapon-state modifier in the HARD-RULE sense — it changes no shot count, no weapon, no cadence.

audit.kitLine: Activates when landing a Full Charge

audit.effectOrReason: buff pierceDamagePct 18.36, durationSec 5, allies. Kept despite the 'inert in v1' note — it is live for any Pierce-tagged ally, including Ade herself once hasPierce is set.

audit.kitLine: Activates only if Spy Lens is at max
audit.effectOrReason: Gate → resourceGate {name:'spyLens', min:10} on a self block; target {kind:'self'} ('Affects self').

audit.kitLine: Gains Pierce. This effect is continuous
audit.effectOrReason: Top-level hasPierce:true (the only Pierce channel that is not swap-scoped or one-shot). Cannot be resource-gated — the ~12 s pre-max window is over-credited; see caveats.

buff atkPct 16 (self-scaling, no 'of the skill user's' qualifier), durationSec 5 re-applied per full charge under the ≥10-stack gate — 'continuously' is realized as a per-charge refresh whose 5 s window outlasts the 2.35 s reload, so it never lapses while she fires.
Header parsed; its only payload (Min Effective Range) is skipped, so no self block is emitted. Trigger for the slot is {kind:'burstCast'} — no 'entering Full Burst' clause anywhere in the burst text.
Same reason as S1b — no range StatKey. Verbatim in unmodeled.burst.
buff attackDamagePct 55.04, durationSec 10, target allies (Damage Up bucket), trigger burstCast.
buff pierceDamagePct 10.13, durationSec 10, allies — same block as the Attack Damage line ('Affects all allies' covers both).

flags.estimate: 10 stacks reached at ~12-13 s (≈10 full charges: 6 shots in ~6-7 s + 2.35 s reload + 4 more), then held for the rest of the fight → gate open ~93% of a 180 s fight.
flags.reasoning: ⚑ Depends entirely on Spy Lens stack-expiry semantics, which the prose does not settle ('stacks up to 10 time(s) and lasts for 5 sec'). REFRESH-ON-STACK (assumed) → reload gap 2.35 s < 5 s so the chain never breaks and 10 is reachable. PER-STACK-INDEPENDENT expiry → only ~5 stacks concurrent (5 s ÷ ~1.0-1.2 s cycle) and the whole S2b block (Pierce + ATK ▲16%) is DEAD FOREVER. The kit's own numbers hint at refresh-on-stack: 10 × 4.44% = 44.4% is clearly designed to be a reachable near-peer of the burst's 55.56%.
flags.recipe: Record a solo Ade fight; watch the Spy Lens buff icon's stack pip — note the timestamp it first reads 10 and whether it ever falls back. If it caps at ~5 and oscillates, flip S2b OFF entirely (delete the block + hasPierce) rather than lowering the gate.

flags.estimate: true, unconditional (real: off for the first ~12 s)
flags.reasoning: ⚑ Pierce is gated on max Spy Lens but the engine's only unconditional-pierce channel is the top-level flag; `pierceModes` keys on user-selectable modes, not stacks. Over-credits her own consumption of the S2a 18.36% / burst 10.13% Pierce Damage buffs during the ramp.
flags.recipe: Same recording as above — once the stack-cap timing is pinned, if the ramp turns out long (>25 s) ask the owner whether to add a stack-gated pierce primitive rather than shipping the unconditional flag.

flags.estimate: ~1.0-1.2 s per full-charge shot cycle, 6 shots then a 2.35 s reload → ~8.4 s per magazine cycle, ~0.72 charges/s
flags.reasoning: ⚑ Datamine-unreliable field class (rate_of_fire / reloadFrames). No rate_of_fire was supplied at all, so the per-shot post-charge recovery is a pure guess. This cadence is LOAD-BEARING twice over: it sets the Spy Lens ramp AND the refresh rate of all three per-charge ally buffs (a cycle slower than 5 s would let the 15.2% / 18.36% / 16% buffs LAPSE between shots).
flags.recipe: Frame-count the ammo counter 6→0 in a solo recording (ammo counter measures shots/sec directly); do NOT infer it from burst-gauge or damage totals.

flags.reasoning: ⚑ Both recurring blocks are keyed 'Full Charge', not 'attack'. `shotFired` = every trigger pull; the mapping is exact only if the engine never fires an uncharged SR shot. If partial charges exist, all three ally buffs over-fire (harmlessly, since they refresh) but the Spy Lens ramp is TOO FAST — the max-stack gate would open early.
flags.recipe: Check whether sim.ts emits shotFired for sub-full-charge SR shots; if it does, gate these blocks on the charge-complete path instead.

flags.estimate: 0 damage impact as modeled; true impact unknown (potentially the ±30% full-range bonus on her own shots and the 'within effective range' gate on both ally buffs)
flags.reasoning: ⚑ 44.4% (stacked) + 55.56% (burst) of a range stat with no schema representation. Skipped honestly rather than proxied into a damage stat — proxying a range buff as, say, attackDamagePct would be exactly the fabrication the prime directive forbids. But this is ~100 percentage points of a kit stat going to zero, so it is the most likely place this override under-models her.
flags.recipe: Owner ruling needed on whether Minimum Effective Range gates the engine's +30% range bonus for SRs; if yes, it needs a real StatKey (engine-modeling-gaps entry) before Ade can be calibrated.

flags.reasoning: ⚑ Not a magnitude flag: `resources` + `resourceGate` were chosen over a `passive` + `rampSec` approximation because they model the actual stack mechanism and are queryable. If validate-overrides rejects `resources` in an OverrideFile, the fallback is a self `passive` buff atkPct 16 with rampSec ≈ 12 (which over-credits the ramp window by ~half, ≈0.5% of fight-total ATK-time — negligible either way).
flags.recipe: Run validate-overrides on a scratch copy (NOT in src/skills/overrides/ during a parallel run); if `resources` is rejected, swap to the rampSec form and keep the caveat text.
